data.gender_notes: Aabirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, 'Aabirah' means 'the last one', often used for the youngest child in a family. The name Aabirah carries the meaning “The last one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aabirah usually hope their child will grow to embody the last one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabirah signifies the one who is the first to witness the divine light, the one who is always awake to the presence of Allah
data.etymology: Aabirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The last one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabirah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name Aabirah holds spiritual significance and is associated with qualities such as movement, progression, and journeying through life.
